premises.text: Hundreds of millions of cars sit parked most of the day, creating car overpopulation
premises.evidence_span: over 250 million cars in America that sit parked 22 hours each day

premises.text: Peer-to-peer marketplace lets owners set price and availability while Getaround provides insurance and takes a commission
premises.evidence_span: Owners that pricing and availability, Getaround provides insurance and takes a 40% commission

premises.text: iPhone app supports browse, request, digital key unlock, and locate for rentals
premises.evidence_span: you get a key on your iPhone app. With it, you can unlock the car and locate the car

premises.text: Low-cost easy-install Car Kit combines keyless remote with Wi-Fi and GPS for smartphone-only access sharing
premises.evidence_span: device that combines a keyless remote with Wi-Fi and GPS

premises.text: Berkshire Hathaway insurance partnership enables national coverage expansion
premises.evidence_span: secured a unique deal with an amazing insurance carrier that will help us expand our coverage across the entire country

value.text: Rent a nearby car instantly or earn by sharing your car instead of buying another
value.evidence_span: Instead of buying a car, you can rent one instantly from someone nearby

secondary_value.text: Reduce cars on the road and CO2 if sharing scales
secondary_value.evidence_span: CO2 emissions would drop by a whopping 48 billion pounds per year

causal_links.evidence_span: solving a problem we call car overpopulation

notes: 1M shared cars vision not a premise (v1.3.2 #4); secondary_value records environmental scale claim. Free signup/no membership fee folded into marketplace offer. Zipcar comparison is framing.
